column3: SisSis
After parting with Kuroneko and Saori, on the way home...
Ah! I just remembered!
What are you raising your voice for? Did you forget something?
Not that. Have you completed "SisSis"?
About that...
What? Don't tell me you haven't played it?
T-That's not it!
Then what is it?
SisSis... It's a great game!
...Hmm, so you haven't played it.
No, look...
I can't believe it. Why haven't you played it?
How long do you think it has been since I lent you "SisSis"?
N-Not good...
Looks like I've incurred her wrath...
If I don't do anything soon...
No, I've played "Miyabi's route".
That route was really great～
Wasn't that the one I played with you?
L-Look... I'm preparing for entrance exams...
What's that? I can't believe it. "Rinko-rin's route" is still---
--No, never mind.
What's wrong?
Nothing at all.
To think you didn't play "SisXSis"...
Oh?
I was ready to withstand at least one roundhouse kick but...
But her reaction is mild...
Anyway, I'll play it properly later...
Shut up.
Besides, why haven't you played it? Isn't it normal to go into other routes after completing Miyabi's?
I don't usually play games. You know that, don't you?
Hah?! That reason is not acceptable!
I know full well that she won't accept a legitimate claim.
As usual, Kirino will lose her temper--
Ahhh, that...
It doesn't feel like I can say I didn't.
I don't think a sound argument can get through to her.
What could be most suitable to trick her...
You haven't, right?
No, I played it yesterday.
...Lies.
It's not a lie!
Yesterday, when I came back home, I started "Rinko's route"...
If you admit that it's a lie right now, I may forgive you.
...It's a lie!
As expected, Kirino's complexion changed in a flash.
But, strangely, she looks pained; is it my imagination?
So... you're not forgiving me at all...?
What I meant was that I'd forgive your lying.
I won't forgive you for not playing "SisSis" though.
